meta.subject: History
meta.source: Government of Tamil Nadu Higher Secondary First Year History, Revised Edition 2025, English and Tamil editions supplied by the user
meta.question_style: Maximum useful source-grounded bilingual competitive-exam coverage from Unit 14: Babur and the four foundational battles; Humayun and the Sur interregnum; Sher Shah's administration; Akbar's conquests, Rajput policy, Mansabdari and religious policy; Jahangir and Nur Jahan; Shah Jahan, Deccan, European settlements and Taj Mahal; Aurangzeb's Rajput, Sikh, Maratha and Deccan policies; Mughal society, economy, trade, religion, science and technology; architecture, painting, music and literature.
meta.quality_policy: Four-option bilingual MCQs grounded in the supplied 2025 English and Tamil textbooks. Activities and low-value procedural material are excluded. Distinct textbook facts are reinforced through direct recall, association, recognition and statement-analysis formats. Source framing is retained even where a detail may differ from other historical accounts.
meta.page_reference_note: page_en refers to the printed English textbook page.

questions.q_en:

II. இந்தியாவில் முகலாயப் பேரரசு நிறுவப்பட்ட ஆண்டு — 1526.

I is incorrect; II is correct
Both I and II are incorrect
questions.exp_en: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
